metadata.coverage_rule: Use actual 1m lidar DEM where available, documented seamless 1/3 arc second USGS DEM outside its footprint
metadata.modifications: Bilinear sampling of real USGS 1m and seamless 1/3 arc second elevation rasters at 32m spacing, subtraction of game elevation origin; no synthetic hills
metadata.overlap_instruction: Root renderer must exclude detailed patch interior and stitch boundary to detailed terrain; horizon samples are independent historical elevations, not road collision.
